01: Classify each AI claim, supply an evidence packet, and state what the conclusion does not prove.
02: Supply an AI task brief, at least three verified repository references, one actual check result and an unresolved product question.
03: Preserve synthetic raw data; supply cleaned analysis, source log, decision memo and an automation boundary. Verify formulas and locale assumptions.
04: Supply a risk-ranked charter covering success, duplicate/concurrent attempts, payment failure, role/tenant, consent, accessibility and recovery; explain the first three tests. For unresolved R8 rules, accept a clarification blocker, decision owner and conditional test; never require invented expectations or payment execution.
05: Supply a journey log for existing contact lookup, allocation loading and simulated send permission in both candidates, with concierge/staff comparison, API evidence and a mobile repeat. Include evidence packet, regression candidate and product uncertainty. Real sign-in, inquiry classification and contact creation/update are not implemented or required.
06: Supply four-lock evidence: Beacon list/direct Atlas detail; cross-tenant owner and same-tenant staff PATCH permission; same-tenant owner positive control; staff UI/API send denial. Report which controls fail in each candidate. PATCH reports persisted:false, not an actual write; 405 means unsupported operation, not isolation proof. Selectors do not prove real authentication.
07: Supply a small patch plus actual red/green outcomes, or an explicitly unexecuted assertion design when tools are blocked. State why the assertion is meaningful and what it does not cover.
08: Supply matched candidate captures at 375/768/1440, viewport/build/OS/browser, keyboard package-selection evidence and user impact. The local target has no menu or overlay. Theme-heading changes are intentional. Require measured contrast for numeric claims; passing keyboard evidence is valid. This text-only reviewer cannot inspect images.
09: Supply an integration map marking implemented/simulated/absent components, healthy and failure/recovery evidence, before/after stored event counts and consent/confidence/state/queued decisions. Rejected attempts save no event. Actual contact mutations, classifier accuracy, real OAuth, queues and message delivery are not implemented; accurate untested limits earn credit. Do not request proof of nonexistent downstream effects.
10: Supply recommendations per evidence round, a factual incident update and any override decision with approval reasoning. Missing or failed checks are not passes.
11: Supply evaluation card, hypothetical role recommendations, new case and dangerous false-pass analysis. Mocks permit binary error rates plus separate ambiguity/boundary verdicts; full completion, evidence rationale, latency and cost are not measured. Never require fabricated metrics or approve a real model from mocks. Optional live trials must separate inputs from labels and provide actual measurement evidence.
12: Supply charter, task brief, evidence, automation proposal or rationale for manual testing, and calibrated verdict with individual reflections using a published capstone card. Public/open-book answers do not replace fresh evidence. Instructor must separately conduct a changed-condition live defense; explicitly unexecuted design routes are valid.
